result:
I’d make disagreement less like combat.

So much of public life rewards humiliating the other person, winning the argument, and never admitting error—not actually understanding anything. I’d change what earns respect: curiosity instead of contempt, clarity instead of cruelty, and being willing to say “I was wrong” without paying for it socially.

It wouldn’t make everyone agree. It would just make it possible to disagree without treating someone as an enemy—and give people room to change their minds without losing their dignity.
